mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by ≥0.25pp over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 3.5% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months where UNRATE > 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations fall, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by ≥0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 295), an increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 295 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 over the past two months signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of months where INDPRO < 104.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of months where PAYEMS increases by ≥50,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% over the past six months signals a slowing economy that reduces corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where GDPC1 growth rate < 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 over the past two months signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profits and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of months where INDPRO < 104.0.
